title: Buyer beware! NOT as advertised!
text: Buyer beware! NOT as advertised!. Talk about disappointment! These containers are TINY! Not at all what is advertised on here! I was expecting an assortment of sizes, with the largest being able to hold a box of cereal. Pfftt! It’ll hold maybe a bowl’s worth and that’s it! These are completely useless and are being returned. Oh, they’re incredibly overpriced as well. Save your money and look elsewhere.
